project.title: TraceForge AI
project.tagline: Evidence-grounded incident copilot with deterministic claim verification.
project.description: TraceForge AI is a human-operated incident copilot for engineers and operators. It turns incident notes and logs into stable evidence line IDs, asks an Investigator model for cited hypotheses, asks a Skeptic model to challenge those claims, and then applies deterministic citation and support checks before any individual finding can become CLAIM PASS. Unsupported findings remain CLAIM HOLD. Model-written summaries and suggested actions are always REVIEW_ONLY and never inherit a verified claim state. Every analysis includes an offline-verifiable integrity receipt bound to the evidence, result, review boundaries, and model identity. Judges can run the complete workflow without an API key using the deterministic local demo, while an operator can optionally configure an authorized OpenAI-compatible inference endpoint for live AI mode.
technology: OpenAI-compatible inference adapter for optional live mode
